personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean (Fused with Tactile structural playfulness for Gen Z)
personality_one_liner: A premium, welcoming, energetic, and clean campus social space driven by structural clarity and vibrant organic accents, avoiding algorithm-driven clutter.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room. Cards never flush to edge, always md/lg margins. 24px padding at screen roots.

screens.name: Auth (SignUp / Login)
screens.purpose: Welcoming entry point with campus backdrop and clean auth fields.

states.error: Inline text below input or subtle error toast

screens.layout: Full-bleed background image with top-down 80% surfaceInverse scrim. Large display wordmark. White/surface solid bottom sheet card holding the auth inputs and sticky CTA.

screens.name: Onboarding (Steps 1-7)
screens.purpose: Multi-step flow capturing interests, personality sliders, and photo without feeling tedious.

states.error: Error toast if photo upload fails

screens.layout: Top progress bar. Large typography for questions. Use wrap grid of pill-shaped chips for interests (brandTertiary for selected). Sticky 'Continue' CTA at bottom.

screens.name: Home
screens.purpose: Personalized dashboard highlighting today's events, potential matches, and active circles.

states.loading: Skeleton cards for matches and events
states.empty: Illustration of students, 'Your campus is quiet today. Create an event!'
states.error: Subtle retry button centered in section

screens.layout: Vertical scroll. Sections with large titles (2xl). Horizontal flatlists for 'Match Cards' (large image + compatibility % badge) and 'Circles'. Event cards are full-width minus padding.

screens.purpose: Explore the campus directory across multiple domains.

states.empty: Empty state illustration + CTA to change filters

screens.layout: Sticky glassmorphic top header with segmented control. 2-column flex-wrap grid for People and Clubs (justifyContent space-between). Single column list for Events.

screens.name: Circles List
screens.purpose: Browse and join small social groups.

states.empty: Empty state art + 'Start a new Circle' CTA

screens.layout: Vertical list. Cards have surfaceSecondary bg, overlapping avatars row, bold title, and a 'Join' pill button.

screens.name: Circle Detail & Chat

states.empty: 'Say hi to your new Circle!' graphic
states.error: Failed to send indicator on message bubble

screens.layout: Glass header with group info and avatars. Chat bubbles with rounded corners (brandPrimary for self, surfaceTertiary for others). Sticky bottom input field in KeyboardAvoidingView.

screens.purpose: Deep dive on event info and finding people to attend with.
screens.layout: Full-bleed hero image. Overlapping content sheet with xl padding. Sticky glassmorphic bottom bar holding the 'Find People to Go With' primary CTA.

screens.name: Match Detail
screens.purpose: Explains why two people matched and facilitates connection.
screens.layout: Large avatar on top half. 'Why you match' explanation blocks (surfaceSecondary chips). Sticky 'Say Hi' CTA at the bottom.

screens.name: Create Menu
screens.purpose: Action sheet to create an event, hangout, or circle.
screens.layout: Bottom sheet or modal. Large tactile touch targets (md radius) with icons and descriptions.

screens.name: Profile
screens.layout: Cover image with vertical gradient scrim. Large circular avatar intersecting the cover and content. Tag wrap layout for interests. List for recent activities.

instructions_to_main_agent: NUCLEAR BAN on Blue, Navy, Purple, Indigo, Orange, and Terracotta. Use the provided mint/emerald (brand: #10B981) for all active states, accents, and CTA buttons.
Use 'Plus Jakarta Sans' for all text (load via expo-font). Weight capped at 500. Let size dictate hierarchy (e.g. 2xl for headings).
Gradient Scrim Mandatory: Any text rendered on top of an image MUST have an expo-linear-gradient behind it (top: transparent, bottom: 80% surfaceInverse). No exceptions.

Sticky CTAs: For screens with primary actions (Onboarding 'Continue', Event 'Find People to Go With'), pin the button at the bottom using a fixed container with safe area insets, independent of the scrolling content.
Implement glassmorphism using expo-blur strictly according to the 'glassmorphism' object in this JSON (e.g., sticky headers and tab bar).
For the 'Discover' screen grids, use single column for Events (width: 100%), and 2-column flex-wrap grids for People (justifyContent space-between). Avoid left-clustered orphans.
Empty and Loading states must flex: 1 and center vertically. Use the provided empty state images (group_laughing or empty_state_friends).
Wire haptics to all major interactions (buttons, tabs, matching) using expo-haptics.
Use Phosphor icons consistently. Ensure hitSlop or minimum 44x44pt size for all Pressable elements.
Maintain generous padding (xl: 24px) at screen roots. Do not let cards sit flush against the screen edges.
Ensure 'brandTertiary' and 'brandPrimary' are used effectively for the interest chip selections in Onboarding.
